prompts:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: production 2D top-down cell-war game heart battlefield, transparent registered cutaway sprite.
Input 1 (heart-anatomy-guide.png) is the exact coordinate/shape layout. Input 2 (baseline-current-composite-context.png) is palette, material, surrounding vascular/tracheal style reference only. Produce ONLY the rebuilt heart and its local vascular connectors, transparent background, no lungs, no trachea, no surrounding organs, no labels or UI.
Match the 1000 x 1410 guide canvas/aspect and every silhouette/chamber/valve position precisely: the upper 20% mostly empty is intentional, keep transparent padding there. Do not center or enlarge the heart independently of the guide. The dark wine silhouette is heart muscle, the four filled interior shapes are OPEN blood-filled fighting spaces, not solid muscle. Render a recognizably anatomical heart cutaway with exactly TWO small rounded upper atria and TWO lower ventricles. Image-left is patient's right: right atrium blue/plum upper left; right ventricle blue/plum crescent lower left curving around the left ventricle. Image-right is patient's left: left atrium warm rose upper right, left ventricle warm coral lower right with thick muscular wall and a tapered apex. Continuous thick central septum separates left/right. Ventricles larger than atria, left ventricular wall noticeably thicker than right. Use the four soft valve passages in the guide as open navigable throats: tricuspid upper left-to-lower left, mitral upper right-to-lower right; narrow pulmonary outflow rises near center-left, aortic outflow rises center-right. Valve leaflets cling to the sides and must not form closed walls over the passages. Preserve those guide passages/contours exactly; no extra tunnels, no left/right shortcuts.
A visually coherent premium stylized biological game painting matching the existing softly lit warm organic map: sculpted coral-red myocardium cut edges, subtle directional cardiac muscle fibres, smooth bevel highlights and warm ambient shadows. Cavity floors subdued liquid dusky mauve for right-heart and muted warm vermilion for left-heart, with gentle dimensional gradients, broad quiet central areas for very small units; restrained trabeculae only along ventricular perimeter. Real organ proportions, no rectangular buildings, no maze rings, no cartoon heart symbol, no random holes, no dense lumps. Not photoreal surgical gore.
Keep local connector paths exactly where shown in guide, sculpted into the myocardium. Purple pulmonary outflow in central left rises to guide x~42%,y20%; the arterial stream leaves lower-right via center-right valve and rises; return vessels enter the upper atria. Material on connector outer ends should match the lavender veins and muted dusty rose arteries in reference 2, with organic continuous tubular walls rather than abrupt cutout stickers. A few subtle coronary vessels run on the outer myocardial rim, not across open cavities. Root ends and silhouette crop/padding must correspond to guide.
Finish with crisp high-detail painted raster quality suitable for a shipping mobile/desktop game texture at close zoom, clean alpha edges, no cast shadow outside silhouette. Do not copy the old C-shaped obstacle rings or tangled interior lines from reference 2. All four open chambers should be unmistakable at a glance. Return a single registered transparent asset.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input1 is the edit target: transparent heart battlefield. Input2 is exact layout guide, not final aesthetics. Keep the complete existing canvas size, transparent padding, heart silhouette, rendering quality, colors, all four chambers and all fixed connector positions.
Correct only the FOUR valve passage openings: currently they look like cup-shaped blind pouches. They must be continuous OPEN blood channels connecting the intended spaces, with visible cavity FLOOR continuous through their mouths. Upper-left atrium joins lower-left ventricle through tricuspid at guide/source x499 y402; upper-right atrium joins lower-right ventricle through mitral at x537 y402. The middle purple pulmonary channel must connect at its bottom to lower-left ventricular cavity through the pulmonary valve at x506 y406 and remain open continuously upward into the tall purple outflow, not end in a tube cap. The short warm aortic channel at source x526 y410 must join lower-right ventricle below and ascend into a distinct warm arterial outflow toward source x533 y375, remaining separated from the left atrium and pulmonary outflow by continuous muscle walls. Guide coordinates reference source canvas x468..568 y326..467; preserve exact registration.
Make valve leaflets delicate short paired flaps hugging the channel SIDE WALLS, with a wide visible open navigable throat, never an enclosing oval or membrane across floor. The minimum throat is 6 source units (6% of image width) across. No new chambers, no leaks across the central septum. Remove the 5th small red cavity currently on middle-right next to the mitral passage: that area is continuous myocardium, exactly FOUR large cavities total. The lower-left ventricular crescent and thick-walled lower-right ventricle remain as in target.
Do not reposition/resize/recompose. Maintain truly transparent alpha background and finest premium painted organic game art. No text, no labels, no UI, no arrows.

Edit Image 1 in place. Image 2 marks the exact FOUR valve correction regions with green capsules; it is only a positional guide, never copy labels or green/cyan/yellow marks.
The purpose is an OPEN CUTAWAY MAP, the whole lumen is exposed. Every green capsule must contain one CONTINUOUS blood-colored FLOOR joining spaces at BOTH ends. Remove the CLOSED CUP bottom edges and remove long enclosing oval valve walls. In the tricuspid capsule (pixel x327, y739..866) remove the white rim at y~870 and blend the blue atrial lumen into the blue lower ventricle, leaving a continuous blue channel. In the mitral capsule (x729,y739..866) remove its white rim at bottom y~870 and connect the coral atrium floor into coral ventricle. In pulmonary capsule (x401,y781..908) completely remove the spoon/cup end at bottom and connect the blue RV floor directly to the blue vertical pulmonary outflow, with an open channel. In aortic capsule (x612,y813..961) REMOVE the entire pale long narrow bag shape and replace it with a clearly open warm red floor extending from the LV lumen upward as a narrow artery outlet. These are not hanging sacs or spoon bowls. Only tiny short curved valve leaflet tips along BOTH SIDES, no tip or wall spanning the lower/upper opening. Treat all four as passages open at top AND bottom.
Fill the unwanted small middle-right fifth red cavity at x840,y825 with the same muscular myocardium around it; exactly 4 large chambers.
Keep all other pixels as close as possible to Image1, particularly transparent empty top padding, silhouette, external roots, four chamber positions, apex, original relative size on canvas and detailed premium painted rendering. Do NOT enlarge or center the heart. The image is in fixed game coordinates; change only small green capsule regions and the unwanted tiny pocket. Transparent background preserved. No text/marks/UI.
